title: Measure and money masters
topic: Length, mass, volume, money and time
goal: I can change units, solve money problems and find how long things last.

learn.intro: Use one unit before you add or take away. 1 m = 100 cm, 1 kg = 1000 g, 1 ℓ = 1000 ml and $1 = 100¢.

example.problem: A ribbon is 2 m 35 cm long. Mei cuts off 80 cm. How long is the ribbon now?
steps: Change to cm: 2 m 35 cm = 235 cm.
example.answer: The ribbon is 1 m 55 cm long.

howto.title: Tips
steps: Write both amounts in the small unit first.
On a time line, jump to the next o’clock.

try.text: A jug holds 2 ℓ 350 ml. Ali pours out 800 ml. The jug now holds {b} ℓ {b} ml.

example2.problem: A film starts at 2:50 pm and ends at 4:20 pm. How long is the film?
steps: Jump to the next o’clock, then to 4:00, then to 4:20.
Add the jumps: 10 min + 1 h + 20 min = 1 h 30 min.
example2.answer: The film is 1 h 30 min long.

items.text: Change the units.
The ruler is shown at real size. Read the length of each object.

parts.label: c
parts.text: The pencil is {b} cm longer than the crayon.

items.explanation: The pencil starts at 3 and ends at 11: 11 - 3 = 8 cm. The crayon starts at 6 and ends at 13: 13 - 6 = 7 cm. The pencil is 8 - 7 = 1 cm longer.

items.text:
The parcels weigh: A 1 kg 80 g, B 1900 g, C 1 kg 8 g, D 1 kg 90 g. Write the letters in order. Begin with the lightest.
{b}  {b}  {b}  {b}
items.explanation: Write each in grams: A is 1080 g, B is 1900 g, C is 1008 g and D is 1090 g. In order: 1008, 1080, 1090, 1900. That is C, A, D, B.

items.text: A jug has 2 ℓ 500 ml of juice. Ali pours it into cups of 400 ml.

parts.label: b
parts.text: {b} ml of juice are left over.

items.explanation: 2 ℓ 500 ml = 2500 ml. 2500 ÷ 400 = 6 remainder 100. He fills 6 cups, and 100 ml are left over.

items.text: Read the water level in each jug.

parts.label: d
parts.text: C has {b} ml more than A

items.explanation: Each small mark is 50 ml. A is 1 mark above 300: 350 ml. B is at 600 ml. C is 1 mark above 800: 850 ml. 850 - 350 = 500 ml.

items.text: A notebook costs $2.65 and a ruler costs $1.40. Mei pays with a $5 note.
Siti has $20 and buys the first 3 things on the list.

parts.label: c
parts.text: Can she buy all 4 things on the list?   {circ:Yes|No}

items.text: A box with 6 books weighs 2 kg 250 g. The empty box weighs 450 g. All the books have the same mass. One book weighs {b} g.
items.explanation: 2 kg 250 g = 2250 g. The books weigh 2250 - 450 = 1800 g. One book: 1800 ÷ 6 = 300 g.

items.text: Write the time in the other kind of time.
items.explanation: After 12 noon, add 12 to the hour for 24-hour time. (b) 1 + 12 = 13. (c) 9 + 12 = 21. For (d) and (e), take away 12: 16 - 12 = 4 and 20 - 12 = 8.

items.text: How long does each take? Use a time line to help.

parts.label: a
parts.text: Aisha’s class: 5:25 pm to 6:40 pm. It lasts {b} h {b} min.

parts.label: b
parts.text: Ben’s class starts at 3:40 pm and lasts 55 minutes. It ends at {b}.

parts.label: c
parts.text: A show ends at 8:15 pm. It is 1 h 45 min long. It starts at {b}.

items.explanation: (a) 5:25 to 6:00 is 35 min, then 6:00 to 6:40 is 40 min. 35 + 40 = 75 min = 1 h 15 min. (b) 3:40 + 20 min = 4:00, then 35 more min = 4:35 pm. (c) 8:15 pm - 1 h = 7:15 pm, then 45 min back = 6:30 pm.

items.text: Write the time shown on each clock.
items.explanation: The short hand shows the hour and the long hand shows the minutes. A: the long hand points at 2, which is 10 minutes, and the short hand is just past 4. B: the long hand points at 9, which is 45 minutes. C: the long hand points at 5, which is 25 minutes.

items.text: A stamp costs 65¢. Kumar buys 8 stamps.

parts.label: b
parts.text: He pays with a $10 note. His change is ${b}.

items.text: The buses leave the interchange every 20 minutes, starting at 06:50. The ride takes 25 minutes. Mei must reach school by 08:15. When does the latest bus she can take leave? {b}
items.explanation: Mei must leave by 08:15 - 25 min = 07:50. The buses leave at 06:50, 07:10, 07:30, 07:50, 08:10. The latest bus that gets her to school in time is the 07:50 bus.
items.hint: Find the latest leaving time first: 08:15 minus 25 minutes.

items.text: A night bus leaves at 22:50 and arrives at 02:10 the next day. How long is the trip? {b} h {b} min
items.explanation: From 22:50 to 24:00 (midnight) is 1 h 10 min. From midnight to 02:10 is 2 h 10 min. 1 h 10 min + 2 h 10 min = 3 h 20 min.
items.hint: Jump to midnight first. Then jump to 02:10.

items.text: 2 notebooks and 3 pens cost $9. A notebook costs $1.50 more than a pen.
items.explanation: The 2 notebooks cost $3 more than 2 pens in all (2 × $1.50). Take that away: $9 - $3 = $6 for 5 pens. One pen costs $6 ÷ 5 = $1.20. A notebook costs $1.20 + $1.50 = $2.70. Check: 2 × 2.70 + 3 × 1.20 = 5.40 + 3.60 = 9.00.
items.hint: Take away the extra $1.50 for each notebook first.

items.text:
Beyond Level 3: A water puzzle.
You have a 3 ℓ jug, a 5 ℓ jug and a tap. The jugs have no marks. You want exactly 4 ℓ.

parts.label: a
parts.text: Fill the 5 ℓ jug. Pour from it into the 3 ℓ jug until full. The 5 ℓ jug has {b} ℓ left.

parts.label: b
parts.text: Empty the 3 ℓ jug. Pour the 2 ℓ into it. Fill the 5 ℓ jug. Pour from it into the 3 ℓ jug until full. The 5 ℓ jug has {b} ℓ left.

items.explanation: (a) The 3 ℓ jug takes 3 ℓ, so 5 - 3 = 2 ℓ are left in the 5 ℓ jug. (b) The 3 ℓ jug holds 2 ℓ and has room for 1 ℓ more. The full 5 ℓ jug gives 1 ℓ, so 5 - 1 = 4 ℓ are left. That is exactly 4 ℓ.
items.hint: Follow each step. The jug is full when it holds 3 ℓ.

items.text: Mei’s watch is 8 minutes slow.

parts.label: a
parts.text: Her watch shows 4:20 pm. The real time is {b}.

parts.label: b
parts.text: A film starts at 4:45 pm. When it starts, her watch shows {b}.

items.explanation: (a) A slow watch is behind: the real time is 8 minutes later: 4:20 pm + 8 min = 4:28 pm. (b) At the real time 4:45 pm her watch shows 8 minutes earlier: 4:37 pm.
items.hint: A slow watch shows an earlier time than the real time.

items.text: Write a shopping story that uses $6.40 and $2.15. The answer to your story must be $4.25.

answer.text: Answers vary. Example: A book costs $6.40 and a pen costs $2.15. How much more does the book cost than the pen? The answer is $4.25.

items.explanation: Check that your story uses both amounts and gives $4.25. The only way is the difference: 6.40 - 2.15 = 4.25. A sum of the two would be $8.55.
items.hint: Which sum or take-away of $6.40 and $2.15 gives $4.25?

items.text: A film lasts 1 h 55 min. It ends at 00:20, just after midnight. At what time did it start? Write it in 24-hour time. {b}
items.explanation: From 00:20 go back 20 min to midnight (24:00). 1 h 55 min - 20 min = 1 h 35 min is left. 24:00 - 1 h 35 min = 22:25. Check: 22:25 + 1 h 55 min = 00:20.
items.hint: Go back to midnight first. Then go back the rest.

A bottle holds 1 ℓ 200 ml. A child drinks 700 ml. The bottle then holds {b} ml.
A film starts at 6:45 pm and ends at 8:10 pm. It lasts {b} h {b} min.
items.explanation: 6:45 to 7:00 is 15 min. 7:00 to 8:00 is 1 h. 8:00 to 8:10 is 10 min. In all: 1 h 25 min.
